project.name: NSE AlgoTrader
project.description: CPU-only ML algorithmic trading system for NSE India equities. Ingests tick data, builds volume bars, engineers microstructure features, generates ML signals, executes via broker APIs with strict risk controls.

hardware.gpu_constraint: ALL_CPU_ONLY — no CUDA, no Metal, no OpenCL, no GPU libraries
hardware.notes: P-cores reserved for latency-critical processes (execution, tick ingestion). E-cores for ML inference and feature computation.

data_storage.protocol: HTTP ILP (port 9000) — questdb.ingress Python client, http:// scheme. Legacy TCP ILP (port 9009) is deprecated; do NOT use.

data_processing.rule: NO pandas in hot path. Polars LazyFrames for batch. Polars Series for feature output.
data_processing.fallback: pandas ONLY for broker API response parsing where unavoidable

ml_models.model_serialization: joblib (training/research); Treelite compiled .so for live inference (reduces predict latency ~40ms → ~2ms)

broker_primary.name: Shoonya (Finvasia)
broker_primary.auth: API key + password + TOTP; session tokens expire daily — monitor proactively with heartbeat [SURV-10]
broker_primary.use_case: PRIMARY execution from Stage 1 — live + paper trading

broker_dev_reference.name: AngelOne SmartAPI
broker_dev_reference.use_case: Development reference ONLY — best docs for initial build. NOT used for live execution.
broker_dev_reference.why_not_primary: TOTP sessions expire mid-day (Critique 24), data throttled 1-3/sec (Critique 10)

data_feed.stage_1: Shoonya WebSocket (throttled 1-3 snaps/sec) — EMA cross paper trading only
data_feed.stage_2A: Shoonya live feed — OHLCV/volume bars only, NO L2 microstructure features
data_feed.stage_2B_and_above: TrueData WebSocket (unthrottled L2) — REQUIRED before enabling Hawkes/VPIN/TFI; historical TrueData data must match live feed schema before any microstructure ML training
data_feed.deprecated_stage_2_angelone: REMOVED — AngelOne SmartWebSocket was listed here incorrectly; AngelOne is dev reference only

ipc.note: Ports match algo_trading/config.py Settings fields. alert_push was added by ARCH-FIX-3.

stack.logging: structlog → QuestDB logs table + rotating file

architecture.data_flow: Broker WebSocket → data/broker_shoonya.py → ZMQ PUB:5555 → features/engine.py → ZMQ PUB:5556 → models/inference_engine.py → ZMQ PUSH:5557 → execution/order_executor.py → Broker API
architecture.bar_note: Stage 1 uses 15-minute time bars. Volume bars require TrueData and are activated from Stage 2A onward. TRAIN_BAR_TYPE must always equal LIVE_BAR_TYPE.

processes.name: DataIngestor + DailyOrchestrator
processes.note: Combined in Stage 1; manages Shoonya WebSocket, session lifecycle, and ZMQ PUB:5555

processes.name: FeatureEngine
processes.note: ZMQ SUB:5555 → compute 25 features → ZMQ PUB:5556

processes.name: MLInference
processes.note: ZMQ SUB:5556 → Treelite .so inference → ZMQ PUSH:5557

processes.name: OrderExecutor + RiskManager
processes.note: ZMQ PULL:5557 → risk gates → Shoonya API

processes.name: AlertSink
processes.note: ZMQ PULL:5560 → Telegram HTTP (decoupled from execution)

stage_definitions.stage_0: Edge proof — validate data availability, run EMA baseline on real historical data, produce net-after-cost walk-forward report. No broker, no ML yet.
stage_definitions.stage_1: Shoonya paper plumbing — EMA cross only, no ML, no microstructure. Prove login/reconnect/candle/paper-order/FSM/kill-switch/reconciliation. (CURRENT)
stage_definitions.stage_2A: Vanilla ML on OHLCV/volume bars — only after Stage 1 runs reliably. No Hawkes, no TFI, no L2 features. Shoonya live feed.
stage_definitions.stage_2B: TrueData premium data integration — subscribe, record historical+live, prove feature distribution parity between training and live. No new live trading on L2 features until parity proven.
stage_definitions.stage_3: Microstructure features — VPIN/Avellaneda filter only if data supports it. Hawkes/TFI only at tick/sub-minute. Feature registry enforces required feed resolution.
stage_definitions.stage_4: F&O only after Stage 3 profitable 3+ months — Rs15L+ lot size req, high STT. Optional advanced models (RL, NLP sentiment, deep time-series) research-only until deterministic baseline profitable.

constraints: CPU_ONLY — no CUDA, no cuML, no TensorFlow GPU
NO_PANDAS_HOT_PATH — Polars only in BarBuilder, FeatureEngine, MLInference
QUESTDB_TIMESERIES_ONLY — no SQLite, no PostgreSQL for tick data
ZEROMQ_IPC_ONLY — no Redis, no Kafka for inter-process messaging
DECIMAL_FOR_MONEY — Python Decimal for all monetary calculations
STRUCTURED_LOGGING — structlog with timestamp_ns, module, symbol
CONFIG_YAML_ONLY — no hardcoded constants in business logic
WALK_FORWARD_VALIDATION — no random split on time series
SHOONYA_PRIMARY — Shoonya is primary execution broker from Stage 1; AngelOne is dev reference only
NSE_SESSION_ONLY — logic active 09:15-15:30 IST on NSE trading days

vpin.formula: VPIN = |V_buy - V_sell| / V_total over rolling N volume buckets

hawkes_process.formula: lambda(t) = mu + sum(alpha * exp(-beta*(t-ti))) for ti < t
hawkes_process.use_case: Detect spoof cancellation cascades and institutional burst firing

avellaneda_stoikov.use_case: Better mid-price estimator during wide bid-ask spread events

tabpfn.status: BANNED — do NOT use in production or paper trading
tabpfn.reason: O(N²) attention mechanism makes inference unusable at any meaningful training size (>500 rows takes seconds). ARCH-FIX-4 removed TabPFN from the architecture entirely.
